phase121LoadTesting.networkConditionSimulated: Bangladesh Broadband/Mobile (95ms base RTT, ±25ms jitter, 1.5% packet loss)

runs.spikeRun: 30 CCU burst, 40 reqs: 29 success, 11 429 throttled, 0% 5xx (empirically confirmed rate limit boundary)

phase121LoadTesting.reclassificationNotice: Reclassified: Executed ~140 HTTP requests to health endpoints (/health, /v1/health, /api/health) and static assets. Not proof of 10,000-user transactional capacity; transactional load testing at 10k scale requires paid infrastructure.

remediatedVulnerabilities.title: Next.js SVG Image Optimization API Remote Code Execution
remediatedVulnerabilities.remediation: Configured images.unoptimized: true in apps/web/next.config.mjs, completely neutralizing the unauthenticated SVG scaling endpoint.

remediatedVulnerabilities.title: PostgreSQL Connection URL Password Leakage with @ Character
remediatedVulnerabilities.remediation: Hardened sanitizeLogString regex in apps/api/src/plugins/logger.ts to match until the final @ preceding the host.

remediatedVulnerabilities.title: Benign Metadata Header Redaction Collateral
remediatedVulnerabilities.remediation: Decoupled header sanitization from body key patterns, preserving content-type while redacting auth tokens and cookies.

remediatedVulnerabilities.title: Mobile Carrier-Grade NAT and Proxy Client Aggregation
remediatedVulnerabilities.remediation: Updated ProcessLocalRateLimiter to parse CF-Connecting-IP and leftmost X-Forwarded-For client IP; enabled trustProxy: true in Fastify; exempted health probes.

safeOperatingBoundaries.supabaseConnectionPoolRule: Supabase Free (15 direct connections) exhausts at > 35 CCU. PgBouncer transaction pooling (60-100 connections) on Supabase Pro is mandatory for >= 5k users.

capacityEnvelopeAndCosts.noExtrapolationPrinciple: Local 100-user synthetic tests execute over zero-latency IPC loopback (<2ms). Real production traffic under Little's Law (L = λW) exhibits 50x-200x higher concurrent in-flight connections due to 95ms-450ms network roundtrips, causing Erlang C queuing saturation cliffs above 75% pool utilization.

backupAndRestoreProof.retentionPolicy: 7-day continuous Point-in-Time Recovery (PITR) on Supabase Pro with daily automated pg_dump snapshots retained for 30 days in off-site S3 storage.
backupAndRestoreProof.stagingRestoreDrillEvidence: Reclassified: Runbook documentation verification (docs/engineering/backup-and-recovery.md Section 4.2). Live database restoration drill was NOT executed and remains an unexecuted blocked gate (evidence-backupRecoveryEvidence in release-preflight).
backupAndRestoreProof.deletionSuppressionLedger: All purged users and workspaces tombstoned in app.deletion_suppression_ledger, preventing accidental resurrection of deleted data from database backups.

severitySLOs.SEV-1: Acknowledged < 15 min, Mitigated < 1 hour (Data loss, system outage, security breach)
severitySLOs.SEV-2: Acknowledged < 1 hour, Mitigated < 4 hours (Core journey degraded, sync failures)
severitySLOs.SEV-3: Acknowledged < 4 hours, Mitigated < 24 hours (Non-blocking visual defect, minor error)

monitoringAndObservability.tracingArchitecture: Correlated across Cloudflare edge (cf-ray), Render container (rndr-id), and Fastify request context (x-request-id UUID).

rollbackPlan.subTenSecondStaticCutover: Instant edge redirection to /offline-shell.html (6,395 bytes standalone reader and outbox viewer) if origin is degraded.
rollbackPlan.immutableDeployRedeploy: Render CLI / dashboard one-click redeploy of previous stable deploy ID or previous commit SHA.
automatedRollbackTriggers: Server 5xx error rate exceeds 1.0% across 5 consecutive minutes
Bangladesh end-user p95 latency exceeds 2,000ms for > 5 minutes
Database connection pool saturation reaches 100% with connection timeouts > 10s for > 60s
Node.js RSS heap saturation exceeds 85% without post-GC recovery

phase1_smallInvitedCohort.monitoringFocus: Zero 5xx errors, sync conflict rate < 0.1%, support ticket response < 2h
phase1_smallInvitedCohort.infrastructure: Render Starter ($7/mo) or Railway Pro ($20/mo) + Supabase Free/Pro

phase2_betaExpansion.monitoringFocus: p95 origin latency < 250ms, memory stability < 350MB RSS

phase3_generalPublicLaunch.gate: Owner authorization of Managed PaaS budget ($80-$160/mo) and Supabase Pro PgBouncer activation

decisionRequired.description: Approval of exact production domain and DNS configuration (app.daynori.com / api.daynori.com on Cloudflare).
Approval of infrastructure spending model: $0-$7/mo for closed beta (<35 CCU) vs $80-$110/mo for Managed PaaS Option 1 (Railway Pro + Supabase Pro + Vercel Pro).
Approval of initial invited cohort size (50-100 users) before wider public promotion.
Explicit owner publication signature authorizing deployment of Candidate 2.0.0-rc5 to approved production destinations.

standingReleaseRule: Never describe a rehearsal, staging deployment, or local smoke test as a public launch. Production launch occurs ONLY after explicit owner approval.
